extracted.intended_audience: postdoctoral researchers and physician-scientists preparing K99/R00 (Pathway to Independence) applications to NIAID/NIH
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for preparing and submitting NIAID/NIH Pathway to Independence (K99/R00) applications, including eligibility rules, allowed research/clinical-trial policy, required application components, award budget/effort limits, and institutional commitments for transition to the R00 phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility — plans to apply for tenure-track assistant professorship
rubrics_metrics.description: To qualify for a K99/R00, you must have plans to apply for a tenure-track (or equivalent) assistant professorship at a U.S. academic institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You do not have to be a U.S. citizen or a permanent U.S. resident. During the initial mentored (K99) phase, you must secure a tenure-track, full-time assistant professor position at an academic institution to transition to the R00 phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree requirements — Parent K99/R00
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH Parent K99/R00: research (Ph.D.) or clinical (M.D., D.O., D.D.S, D.M.D., D.V.M., V.M.D., Pharm.D.) or be a nurse with a research doctoral degree.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure your degree matches one of the listed eligible degrees for the Parent K99/R00.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree requirements — NIAID Physician-Scientist (PS) K99/R00
rubrics_metrics.description: NIAID PS K99/R00: clinical doctorate degree (M.D., D.O., D.D.S, D.M.D., D.V.M., V.M.D.) or be a nurse with a research doctoral degree who proposes at least one clinical or translational research aim on the proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: At this time, individuals with a Pharm.D. degree are not eligible to participate in the NIAID PS K99/R00 program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postdoctoral experience limit (4-year rule)
rubrics_metrics.description: For both opportunities, you must have no more than 4 years of postdoctoral research training as of the relevant new or resubmission application due date. Only time dedicated to research activities counts toward the 4-year limit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The following circumstances are not considered part of the 4-year eligibility limit: parental or other well-justified leave; time spent conducting postgraduate clinical training or other well-justified training that does not involve research; time spent gaining select agent approval and completing BSL-4 training. Email the AI Training Help Desk to seek approval to submit a proposal beyond the 4-year limit; approval is considered case-by-case.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check Notices of Funding Opportunities (NOFO) / NOSI participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for K99/R00 Funding Opportunities to get a current list. If applying to a NOSI, check the NOSI for the table of relevant NOFOs through which you can apply and confirm that NIAID is participating in your chosen NOFO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The title of each opportunity announcement indicates whether independent clinical trials are allowed or required. Confirm NIAID participation and the NOFO-specific rules before applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical trial policy per announcement
rubrics_metrics.description: The title of each opportunity announcement indicates whether independent clinical trials are allowed or required. NIAID will not accept Parent K99/R00 applications proposing an independent clinical trial; the Institute will accept PS K99/R00 applications proposing an independent clinical trial.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are considering a clinical trial opportunity, review 'Clinical Trials and NIAID Research Career Development (K) Opportunities' for details and NOFO-specific guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award duration and non-renewability
rubrics_metrics.description: NIAID encourages applications requesting up to 2 years for the K99 and 3 years of support for the independent R00 phase of the award. These awards are not renewable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Request appropriate durations in the application (up to the suggested limits); plan for transition to the R00 within the supported period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Salary cap and fringe benefits
rubrics_metrics.description: Salary up to $100,000 (if institutional base salary is equivalent or more) plus fringe benefits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Request salary consistent with institutional base salary up to the stated cap; include fringe where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research development costs (RDC) limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Research development costs up to $50,000 each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget RDC within this per-year cap.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Administrative (F&A) costs for K99 phase
rubrics_metrics.description: For K99 phase, facilities and administrative costs based on 8 percent of modified total direct costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculate F&A at the stated 8% MTDC rate for the K99 phase budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum effort requirement — Parent K99/R00
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimum 9 person months (or 75 percent) effort required each year for the Parent K99/R00.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure appointment/effort commitments documented in application meet or exceed 9 person months (75%) annually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum effort requirement — NIAID PS K99/R00
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimum 6 person months (or 50 percent) effort required each year for the NIAID PS K99/R00.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure appointment/effort commitments documented in application meet or exceed 6 person months (50%) annually for the PS variant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required application components
rubrics_metrics.description: When you apply, include a career development plan, Research Plan with a description of the project you will pursue in the R00 phase, and at least three letters of reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For the PS K99/R00, at least one Specific Aim must be in clinical or translational research. Ensure the Research Plan describes the R00-phase project specifically and that referees provide letters as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional commitment letter for R00 phase
rubrics_metrics.description: To qualify for the independent investigator (R00) phase, the chair of the division or department where you have secured a faculty position must submit a letter demonstrating the institution's commitment to provide you with protected research time, space, facilities, and other support needed to conduct the proposed research as a tenure-track faculty (or equivalent) member.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obtain and include a clear institutional commitment letter from the department/division chair confirming protected time, space, facilities, and other necessary support for the proposed R00 research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference to SOPs and application advice
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn more in our Pathway to Independence Awards Parent K99/R00 and NIAID Physician-Scientist K99/R00 SOP. Also check our Application Advice for Research Career Development (K) Awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the SOP and application-advice pages for detailed procedural and format requirements beyond the high-level points on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility assistance and alignment check
rubrics_metrics.description: NIAID can advise you on your eligibility for a particular K program and whether your proposed research aligns with NIAID if you send your NIH-formatted biosketch and Specific Aims page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email the AI Training Help Desk to request pre-submission eligibility/fit advice; provide biosketch and Specific Aims for review.
